edit.description: lifted_location: declare a location wherever the read path differs from the templates' whole placement, named-field included
named-field member whose field differs from its stem

summary: Install's lift declares a member's location whenever its kind's templates would not place its name back at its read path, so a named-field member re-emits where it was found
acceptance: Represented install over a named-field kind whose `name` differs from the file stem lifts a location; the first emit rewrites no path and check is clean
tests: lift declares a location for a named-field member whose field differs from its file stem
notes: From build note MEMBER-PLACEMENT-IS-A-DECLARED-ROW-FACT: lifted_location gates on a `:` in the id, so `name: Teaching Mode` in teach.md re-emits at `Teaching Mode.md`. Criterion per the note: read path != whole placement.
